purpose: Additive path mapping for unchanged source receipt bytes after deduplication; original provenance is not rewritten.

verification.scope: current working-tree file bytes and pinned historical Git blobs

hash_semantics.receipt_sha256: The source-file SHA-256 recorded by the unchanged original provenance document.
hash_semantics.current_sha256: SHA-256 of the current canonical file read during this review.
hash_semantics.receipt_document_sha256: SHA-256 of the whole unchanged provenance JSON document.
